title: Sprint! The Turf Leading to Tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Well, Instructor! How'd I do?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...I have to say, you did much better than I
thought possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We invited the class instructor to watch a
lap on turf. Bamboo was
really hoping it'd
reassure her that it's safe, but the
instructor has a
stiff, blank expression.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
R-right? So, um... I know this goes against
what you recommended,
but still! I really
think I'm in good shape to run turf at the
Tracen
Meet!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...That run demonstrated your strength,
loud and clear. I see how
passionate you
are about turf. However...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text: I would like to hear your thoughts as well, Trainer. Are you confident that you can keep Bamboo Memory both safe and successful on turf?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but hesitate. If I switch
Bamboo over too soon, it could
affect the
rest of her career. I know that, but... But!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! YEAH! I'm ready! I'll be completely
fine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Bamboo's choice to make, not mine.
She wants to run turf, so
I'll do everything
in my power to support that.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Instructor
text_block_list.text:
I see. You're a lucky one, Bamboo. It
seems that you've found yourself
an
excellent partner.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that resolved, we sign up Bamboo for
the Tracen Meet's
1,600-meter turf
race—the goal she's been working so hard
towards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We arrive at the Meet in pouring rain, but
luckily it clears up in the
afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I can't say I'm surprised, but it kinda
stings that Oguri didn't
recognize me.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri! Good morning! Here's to a good
match today!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you running in the same race as
me? Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
When she leaves the track today, she's
gonna know my name—I swear
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Remember the plan—stick right behind
Oguri! Don't jump to the lead
yet, even if
it seems tempting!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Just stay steady! Don't lose my cool! And
don't forget what Trainer
said!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory usually leaps ahead, but
she's hanging near the
back today! Is she
playing things safe for her first ever turf
race?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why did you stop me? I was off to a
super great start!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Isn't that the best time to go
all-out and shoot ahead,
though? The
start's when I've got the most energy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way. I always do it just like my red-hot
routine! Step by step, a
little each da—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Wait! I've gotta take races
step-by-step too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo's greatest strength is the red-hot
passion she pursues her
dreams with. I
want her to hide it—to feint her rivals out,
then blast
past them at the end.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(We've been working towards this, day by
day. The steady approach
got me this far!
So now—)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Now I've just gotta believe! I believe in
Trainer! My dreams! And
myself!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The front pack is still closely-knit as our
racers begin rounding the
fourth corner!
They're almost at the final—oh?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory shoots ahead on the
outside! What incredible
speed! She wasn't
struggling on the turf—she was just biding
her time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(C'mon, c'mon! I've gotta catch her! I'm
gonna reach my rival—and
then surpass
her!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: TYAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm standing just before the goal. There's a
howling blast of wind as
Bamboo charges
past me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in that moment, I could have sworn
Bamboo Memory was in front
of Oguri
Cap.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Is it Oguri? Or Bamboo?! It might be Oguri! And it is Oguri Cap, first to finish!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is second by just a nose!
What a heart-pounding
finish! In third,
there's—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... AAAAGH! I can't believe I lost!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're... Bamboo Memory, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nn? Wh-whoa! Oguri! That was some great
running out there! But um,
how did you
know my name?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
With the caster shouting it like that, it'd
be hard not to remember...
And... that was
an amazing race. I hope to run with you
again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of... OF COURSE! I promise—you haven't
seen the last of me, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo is her usual bright, sporty self for
the rest of the Tracen
Meet, but the
second we get back to my office, she lets
out a choked
breath.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Sob! It's just—it's so, so frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We will! And you'll be with me as my
trainer, right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod and meet her gaze. We'll take Oguri
Cap down in the Twinkle
Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us have only just started our
journey together, but
knowing Bamboo,
there'll be no shortage of red-hot battles
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm lookin' forward to it,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the fire in her heart, she'll burn
through any obstacles in her
path.
